items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 21 at 12:27PM EST until November 22 at 4:00AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 3 to 6 feet in the surf zone.

* WHERE...Coastal Horry and Coastal Georgetown Counties.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 21 at 10:53AM EST until November 22 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
6 to 9 ft.

* WHERE...Northeast South Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
